findings.title: Real proving candidates are isolated fixture code changes
findings.invariant: Real evolution must mutate real code and measure real behavior without touching live/protected systems
findings.reproduction: All 4 cycles mutate real micro_target code in isolated git clones under JARVIS_R11_TEMP; baseline probe fails 4/4 and baseline pytest 2/6, candidates measurably improve or fail; no live daemon/db/vault/protected main touched; mirrors reproduced identical counts and metrics.

findings.title: Independent verification is a fresh subprocess with no candidate context
findings.invariant: No candidate may certify or promote itself; verifier must be independent and fresh
findings.reproduction: Each request rebuilds the candidate from a fresh baseline clone via python -m jarvis_foundry.evolution_live.verifier; ledger records source_type independent_verifier; engine refuses verifier ids equal to candidate ids; R11_VERIFIER_REPRODUCTION.json and mirror g04 passed with fresh ids.

findings.title: Mirror static and confinement need mirror-local tool config and a git-backed mirror
findings.invariant: Mirror gates must reproduce repo truth without editing repo source or evidence
findings.reproduction: A temp copy outside the repo lacks pyproject.toml, so ruff used default line length and mypy lost config (mirror-only artifact; identical files pass in repo). Fixing only the mirror-local pyproject (ruff/mypy/bandit kept, pytest addopts removed to avoid summary suppression) plus MYPYPATH made static pass; g06 confinement requires a git-backed mirror whose porcelain matches the 10 expected untracked trees. Final clone mirror reproduced all gates exit 0; no repo source or evidence changed.

findings.title: Pytest summary lines are suppressed by double -q in captured raw evidence
findings.invariant: JUnit counts and exit codes remain authoritative where raw output lacks a final N passed summary
findings.reproduction: Repo pytest config addopts=-q plus CLI -q suppresses the summary in captured focused/full raw files; JUnit and fresh runs confirm 13 focused and 1483 combined with 0 failures/errors; mirror with addopts removed printed exact 13 passed and 1483 passed.

findings.title: External live supervisor process drift is documented and not R11-attributable
findings.invariant: Protected-state comparison must not mask attributable mutation
findings.reproduction: Builder full-window comparison observed 4->2 unrelated supervisor processes and recorded protected_state_unchanged=False with r11_attributable_mutation=False; quiet-window comparison and both fresh mirror windows recorded protected_state_unchanged=True and r11_attributable_mutation=False with no KeyError.

findings.title: Pre-existing tests/foundry scheduler flake not observed in this round
findings.invariant: Known timing flakiness must be classified honestly and never edited away
findings.reproduction: Split part1 (foundry + r6..r10) and mandatory combined 1483 passed on first independent attempts; no tests/foundry file was edited; if the known whole-second flake appears on future retries it must be retried untouched.
